routes.selection_condition: Select only if every listed proof obligation is discharged without retroactive circularity.
required_proofs: Every intervening packet was produced from its authorized predecessor.
All scientific inputs and outputs are byte-identifiable.
No stage depended on later mutable-checkout conditions.
Validation results are reproducible or properly frozen as historical evidence.
No maintenance modification changed scientific meaning.
The sequence contains no unauthorized target jump.
Each transition can be adopted in order without retroactive circularity.
routes.authority_progression_rule: Advance through each accepted transition in required predecessor order; do not jump directly to the July 19 selector.

routes.selection_condition: Select when the preserved historical chain cannot be adopted exactly.
required_decisions: Identify the preserved artifacts admissible as inputs.
Identify the artifacts retained as historical but non-authoritative.
Identify the decisions that must be regenerated.
Identify the computations that may not be rerun.
State whether preserved observations may be used and the exact non-decision-bearing purpose.
Define the exact new authority path from the July 12 scientific target.
Explain why the route does not retroactively legitimize unauthorized work.
routes.authority_progression_rule: Create a bounded prospective authority chain from the frozen July 12 target; preservation alone confers no scientific adoption.

preserved_conditional_terminal_selector.reachability_condition: May be reached only after a separately authorized route validly reconciles or adopts every required predecessor transition.

meaning_if_later_authorized: The analytic production kernel remains neither qualified nor refuted.
The consumed sandbox execution cannot be rerun automatically.
Direct pipe repair followed by rerun remains prohibited.
No production, validation, or scientific-success claim follows.
Reopening requires new authority and a specifically named permissible consumer.
Without such a consumer, the path remains indefinitely deferred.
